caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass vase rendered in shades of blue. The vase has a narrow neck that flares outward at the top into a wavy, scalloped rim. Its body is bulbous in the upper part and then tapers down to a narrower base, with visible contour lines to suggest its transparent and reflective glass material. The vase is positioned upright on a plain, beige background, and there are two elliptical, pale blue shadows cast to the lower left of the vase, one overlapping the other, suggesting a light source coming from the right. There are no additional objects, textures, or patterns present in the composition.
title: Lamp Chimney
